 EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Automation Tester in JavaScript to check the quality of the deliverables within the Operational Risk platforms, helping create the next big thing in digital banking. This role requires hands-on test automation expertise with governance and ownership.
 Responsibilities
Define and drive test strategy and quality standards across applications
Establish measurable quality KPIs (defects, coverage, efficiency)
Ensure audit-ready traceability of testing artifacts
Oversee test planning, execution, and defect management
Coordinate with development and product teams for issue resolution
Support release governance and sign-offs
Act as QA point of contact for senior stakeholders
Provide quality reporting and risk visibility
Promote best practices and quality-first culture
Design and maintain automation frameworks integrated in CI/CD
Drive adoption of BDD and API testing (Cypress, REST, JSON)
 Requirements
5+ years of experience in software testing, preferably on highly available and distributed microservices
ISTQB certification
Expertise in automation frameworks (Cypress / BDD)
Proficiency in Web Services/API testing (REST, JSON) using Swagger/Postman
Skills in CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Git)
Basic knowledge of Java
Strong knowledge of Oracle / SQL
Strong English skills and stakeholder management
Analytical mindset and problem-solving skills
High ownership and autonomy
English proficiency at B2 level or higher
 Nice to have
Knowledge of Docker / Kubernetes
